mapping_boundary: Source-backed organization only. No browser, runtime, responsive, localization, test-execution, ontology, or cross-game claim is made.

identity.statement: The catalog entry id is alchemists-synthesis and its title is Alchemist's Synthesis.
The catalog description concerns matching and merging vocabulary; the catalog supplies the cover path, student href, and playable status.

state.statement: State creation selects maxRounds as 5 for easy, 7 for normal, or 10 for hard, and initializes idle status, zero score and answer counters, round 1, and the selected difficulty.

mechanics.statement: For a non-null current word, option generation filters differing terms, takes the first three, and shuffles the current item with those wrong options; a null current word yields no options.

transitions.statement: Time advancement leaves non-playing state unchanged and changes a playing state to gameover when accumulated time reaches 60000 milliseconds.

Answer handling compares terms, increments correct answers only on a match, increments attempts, adds 10 score for a match, advances the round, and ends after maxRounds with victory at least half correct or gameover otherwise.

results.statement: Results calculate accuracy from correctAnswers and totalAttempts and XP as floor(correctAnswers multiplied by accuracy), and return score, counts, gameTime, and difficulty.

controls_and_completion_wiring.statement: The component initializes game state with difficulty normal.
Selecting an option calls handleAnswer and calls onComplete when the new status is victory or gameover.

data_and_routes.statement: The page fetches vocabulary from the alchemists-synthesis vocabulary API and uses a nonempty returned array, otherwise assigning a five-item fallback list.
Completion handling POSTs to the alchemists-synthesis complete API with XP as score, answer counts, percentage accuracy, and difficulty.
The vocabulary route creates GET by passing SAMPLE_VOCABULARY to createVocabularyRoute.
